title: shimr ne pehle sakina ko dikhaaya khanjar
body:
Wa ghareeba.. Wa Hussaina
Haaye Hussain
<<MINI>>
Shimr ne pehle sakina ko, dikhaya khanjar..(2)
Shimr ne pehle sakina ko dikhaya khanjar..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Baad mein gardan e sarwar pe chalaya khanjar
<<MINI>>
Shimr ne pehle sakina ko, dikhaya khanjar
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Haaye..
Kabhi Haider ne gala rakha, kabhi Zahra ne..(2)
Kitne masoom pe zalim ne chalaya khanjar
2. Baap par waar to beti pe tamache barse..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
jab bhi qatil ka sakina ne hataya khanjar
3. Ek anguthi ke liye kaat di angusht e hussain..(2)
laash par sheh ki tujhe rehem na aaya khanjar
4. Qatl zainab ko kiya cheen ke chadar sar se..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
is tarha shimr ne naize ko banaya khanjar
<<MINI>>
Shimr ne pehle sakina ko, dikhaya khanjar
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Ek sharabi ko azeeyat ka kaha'n andaza..(2)
jis tarha chaha sitamgar ne chalaya khanjar
6. Aaye sajjad jo bazaar e madina mein kabhi..(2)
badhke qassab ne jaldi se chupaya khanjar
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Pher kar muh ko Ali kehne lage ya Zahra..(2)
itni be dardi se..
itni be dardi se zalim ne phiraya khanjar
8. Haaye..
<<DIVIDER>>
Wa hussaina ka hua shor 'takallum' barpa..(2)
shimr mukhtar ke jab saamne laaya khanjar
<<MINI>>
Shimr ne pehle sakina ko, dikhaya khanjar
